## Client

### Fixed
- A launcher with automatic updates turned off now says so. The version in the corner reads "updates off" next to the version number, and the Settings toggle explains that with updates off you stay on your current version while servers and other players move ahead.
- An update opt-out left behind by a development or side-loaded session no longer silently governs an installed launcher. On an installed copy, update polling that was never turned off through the Settings screen is turned back on once, with a log line. A choice made through Settings is recorded as yours and is never overridden.
- Turning the update toggle on or off now takes effect immediately instead of on the next launch, and turning it on checks for an update right away.
